content:
andrew: Quick idea: switch to a cohort/quorum migration model for model version rollouts. Safer tenant migrations without a global hard pin.
andrew: TL;DR: define migrations with ordered cohorts, each cohort has a traffic_pct, quorum_pct, and grace_window. Advance only when cohort meets quorum. Soft pins allow clients to probe new variants; hard pins force resolver-level binding.

andrew: Example metadata (pseudo): {migration_id:migr_2026_03_cohort_v1, cohorts:[{id:c1,traffic_pct:5,quorum_pct:90,grace_window_s:900},{id:c2,traffic_pct:20,quorum_pct:92,grace_window_s:1800}], global_fallback_variant:v-stable, soft_pin:true, auto_rollback_policy:sla+err_rate}

maria: Clarify quorum_pct: success of model outputs vs infra health?
andrew: Composite. Proposal: 60% functional correctness (smoke evals, regen diffs), 40% infra health (latency, errors). Store separate fields for visibility.
sam: SDK/client concern: soft_pin=true means clients may route new variant; Dedicated pools could see inconsistent placements and affect isolation.
andrew: For Dedicated, cohort label travels with routing. If dedicated pool can't satisfy new variant, we route to fallback_variant for that tenant. Placement preserves isolation.
devon: Telemetry: what probes to emit to evaluate quorum?
andrew: Emit cohort_probe.{start,success,failure,regen_diff} with tags tenant,cohort,variant,commit,latency_ms,err_code. Maintain rolling stats: success_rate, p95_latency, token_cost_delta.
andrew: Example probe (pseudo): {event:cohort_probe_success,tenant:acct_42,cohort:c1,variant:v2alpha,success_rate:0.94,p95_ms:120}
kevin: Contracts: Reserved/Dedicated customers might have hard pins. Do migrations override contractual pins?
andrew: Never override. Migration metadata is advisory unless tenant-level hard_pin=false. For Reserved tiers default to hard_pin semantics unless customer opts into cohort migrations.
maria: Add migration_tier (low/medium/high) so SRE/support know expectations?
andrew: Yes. migration_tier influences quorum thresholds and grace_window defaults (high -> stricter thresholds and longer windows).
sam: Autosafety proposal: auto_rollback_policy detailed thresholds. E.g., if error_rate > 1.5x baseline over 10m OR quality_regression > 5% on smoke set -> rollback to previous cohort + alert.
andrew: We'll codify auto_rollback_policy as list items like ["infra:err_rate","quality:smoke_delta"] with params.
ops-bot: test-run: migration metadata validation passed for migr_2026_03_cohort_v1 on staging :white_check_mark:
kevin: LGTM. Need RFC appendix and Dedicated examples.
maria: +1. Please add appendix explaining binary semantics of soft_pin vs hard_pin. @andrew
andrew: I'll draft the appendix and add resolver pseudocode today. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
